milestones.title: M1 — Decisions and validation
milestones.description: Accept requirements/ADRs/contracts, validate journeys and official routes. No broad feature work before #1 acceptance.

milestones.title: M2 — Offline end-to-end text slice
milestones.description: Build local text analysis, exposure routing and authenticated incident save/reopen. Exit: #21 demonstrated offline.

milestones.title: M3 — Evidence and incident workflow
milestones.description: Complete incident management, immutable evidence and reviewed export.

milestones.title: M4 — Screenshot review and local OCR
milestones.description: Selected images, offline OCR and correction without changing originals.

milestones.title: M5 — Evaluated beta and handoff
milestones.description: Held-out evaluation, device/security/accessibility gates, demo and release handoff.

issues.title: Review and accept product, architecture and privacy baseline
issues.scope: Review PRD/SRS, technology alternatives, ADRs, database, contracts, threat model and release gates. Confirm team skills and weekly capacity; adjust estimates before bootstrap.
acceptance: All three developers record review of their interfaces and responsibilities
PR is merged with cross-workstream approval; assumptions and exclusions are explicit
Any changed decision updates ADR, contract and affected backlog before feature work
issues.tests: Run foundation validation and trace each SRS requirement to an owned issue. No application implementation is claimed.

issues.title: Validate and maintain official India response guidance
issues.scope: Verify bank/1930/NCRP and Chakshu routing using current official sources. Complete the live-form verification that automated access could not perform, without submitting fictional reports.
acceptance: Record live route access date, category distinctions and sources; reconcile timing differences without inventing deadlines
Review contracts/guidance.json with another developer and record reviewer/date
Financial-loss route takes priority; no claim of automated filing or guaranteed recovery
issues.tests: Check allowed destinations, stale/review-age behavior, no sensitive query parameters and correct urgent route on paid=YES.

issues.title: Validate user journeys and accessible prototype with synthetic scenarios
issues.scope: Create low-fidelity intake, results, exposure, incident and export flows. Test with 5–8 consenting adults using fictional messages; do not retain identifying data.
acceptance: Record task completion and misunderstandings with counts and limitations
No participant interprets no-signals result as guaranteed safe; revise copy otherwise
Record team skills/access needs and unsupported-language expectations
issues.tests: TalkBack/focus and 200% text review on prototype where possible; check urgent help is reachable without analysis.

issues.title: Bootstrap pinned Android app, core and data modules
issues.scope: Create Kotlin/Compose app, pure Kotlin core and Android data modules with manual injection. Pin compatible JDK/Gradle/AGP/Kotlin/dependencies and check in verified wrapper.
acceptance: Fresh checkout builds documented debug artifact and runs core tests
Module dependencies keep core free of Android and I/O
Merged manifest has minimal permissions; no network or inbox access; toolchain documented
issues.tests: Clean build, wrapper/dependency checksum verification, emulator launch and module boundary check.

issues.title: Implement versioned domain contracts and fixture compatibility
issues.scope: Implement AnalysisInput/Result, ExposureAnswers, repository command/result and guidance identifiers from shared schemas. Define UTF-16 spans and code-point limits.
acceptance: Kotlin fixtures match JSON v1 examples and reject unsupported versions
Errors distinguish validation, key, storage and cancellation failures without private payloads
Contract changes require ADR and both consumer owners reviewing
issues.tests: Boundary lengths, enum values, missing fields, Unicode spans and serialized round trip.

issues.title: Add Android CI, dependency checks and test foundations
issues.scope: Extend foundation workflow with core tests, Android lint and build; add Room/UI test harness. Pin Actions, minimal permissions, no real data artifacts.
acceptance: Clean PR runs reproducible tests/build/lint
Document physical-device tests CI cannot prove
Record stable check names before proposing required-check settings
issues.tests: Demonstrate one intentional fixture failure is caught locally, then restore passing tests; inspect artifact/log content.

issues.title: Implement share and paste intake with safe result states
issues.scope: Build navigation, text preview, explicit analyze, cancellation, result/uncertainty and empty/error states. No inbox or clipboard monitoring.
acceptance: User can paste/share up to 20k code points and review before analysis
Suspicious URLs are defanged and never navigated; original text remains available to user
Oversize/unsupported/empty input is explained; process recreation does not persist plaintext drafts
issues.tests: Share intent injection, oversized/Unicode text, cancel, rotation/process death, TalkBack and large font tests.

issues.title: Implement explainable local text indicators and coverage handling
issues.scope: Build deterministic bounded rules for explicit secret/APK requests, pressure plus sensitive action and advance-fee patterns. Treat negation/quoted safety advice carefully; no LLM.
acceptance: Findings have stable IDs, spans and explanation keys with rulesVersion
NO_SIGNALS never asserts safety; unsupported content is UNASSESSED
Repeated phrases do not inflate severity; behavior matches frozen rule policy
issues.tests: Unit cases for benign alerts, negations, mixed/unsupported language, adversarial repetition and 20k latency budget.

issues.title: Implement bounded structural URL parsing without network access
issues.scope: Extract up to 20 URL candidates, preserve originals, normalize host for display and explain structural cues. Avoid live fetch, redirects, executable schemes and unvalidated domain reputation.
acceptance: IP/userinfo/punycode/short-link cues explain limitations rather than asserting fraud
Parser enforces candidate/length bounds and maps spans to reviewed text
No DNS/HTTP requests or clickable submitted links; malformed input fails safely
issues.tests: Test encoded separators, suffix deception, IPv6, ports, Unicode, punctuation and pathological regex inputs.

issues.title: Demonstrate offline text-to-incident-to-response vertical slice
issues.scope: Integrate intake, local findings, exposure routing, minimal authenticated save/reopen and curated guidance. This is the first end-to-end value demonstration, before screenshot/export completion.
acceptance: Synthetic case completes whole flow in airplane mode and reopens after restart
Urgent financial-loss help works from home without a message or saved incident
Record a reproducible demo and current limitations; no real call/report is made
issues.tests: End-to-end UI test plus physical-device walkthrough; raw storage/log checks and no app-network traffic.

issues.title: Implement encrypted incident repository and migration-safe persistence
issues.scope: Implement Room metadata and encrypted sensitive payloads, per-incident IDs/keys, timeline/exposure records, transactional create/update, and delete recovery. Pair with #55 before accepting real evidence.
acceptance: Offline create/get/list/update/delete obey contracts and FK ownership
Staging/deletion recovery is idempotent under crash and storage-full conditions
Versioned migration preserves data; no destructive fallback or plaintext notes/title/message columns
issues.tests: Room migration, cross-incident references, repeated create idempotency, interrupted save/delete and ciphertext inspection.

issues.title: Implement independent exposure questionnaire and urgent-help entry
issues.scope: Ask clicked, secret disclosed, installed/remote access and paid with YES/NO/UNKNOWN. Do not request actual credentials. Permit urgent help without analysis.
acceptance: Answers persist only on explicit save and can be changed with timeline event
Unknown is not coerced to no; paid=YES surfaces urgent help before evidence forms
Accessible questions use non-blaming language and work offline
issues.tests: All answer states, no-content entry, back navigation, TalkBack and safe cancellation.

issues.title: Implement curated guidance catalog and exposure routing
issues.scope: Load versioned reviewed guidance; deterministic routing independent of risk score. Support exact allowlisted browser destinations and user-triggered dialer via UI.
acceptance: All 81 exposure combinations have expected action ordering
Paid=YES includes bank/1930/NCRP; stale bundle does not hide urgent basics
Source/date and local-only action progress shown; no procedure generated from message text
issues.tests: Schema/destination checks, invalid bundle fallback, 90-day staleness, unknown answers and no private URL parameters.

issues.title: Implement and audit vault authentication, backup exclusion and deletion
issues.scope: Build device-authenticated Keystore wrapping and incident data-key envelope. Require secure device lock for durable save, lock on background timeout, test backup/D2D exclusions and lost-key handling.
acceptance: Authenticated reads fail closed while locked and after key invalidation; no silent reset
Sensitive files/DB/cache excluded from cloud and device-transfer backups on supported OS versions
Delete-all destroys keys and removes local copies; user sees recovery/export limits
issues.tests: GCM tamper/AAD swap, lock/biometric changes, backup inspection, logcanary, process death and cache cleanup. Independent security review required.

issues.title: Build incident list, detail and local timeline management
issues.scope: Complete case navigation, edit/append event actions, archive/reopen, user-entered official references and delete confirmations. Do not imitate official case status.
acceptance: Saved cases list/reopen offline with paginated metadata
Archive is separate from deletion; user-entered reference explicitly labeled
Timeline keeps assessment versions and distinguishes user-reported times from import times
issues.tests: Empty/large lists, update/archive/delete, corrupt/key-unavailable states, accessibility and process recreation.

issues.title: Preserve immutable encrypted evidence with crash-safe file handling
issues.scope: Implement validated file staging, immutable original bytes/digests, metadata, per-case limits and original/derived distinction. Use generated paths and safe ContentResolver handling.
acceptance: Original decrypted bytes hash matches import; correction never overwrites original
10MiB/20MP, 25 items/case and 250MiB total limits fail with clear errors
Interrupted imports/deletes cannot expose plaintext or leave visible partial records
issues.tests: Hostile provider, revoked URI, malformed MIME, traversal, decompression bounds, disk-full and staged-crash recovery tests.

issues.title: Implement selected screenshot import and review
issues.scope: Add picker/share image adapter, safe preview, MIME/magic checks and byte/pixel limits. Allow only single PNG/JPEG import; no broad gallery permission.
acceptance: User can select, preview and cancel without durable save
Refused URI/format/oversize errors are useful and preserve existing case
Original image is passed through immutable vault path only on explicit save
issues.tests: Permission/grant revocation, cancelled picker, huge image header, process death and no plaintext cache residue.

issues.title: Integrate bundled Latin OCR with correction and offline tests
issues.scope: Run bundled on-device ML Kit OCR on bounded decode, display editable text and mark it as derived. Route confirmed text through same analysis contract.
acceptance: Cold-start OCR works in airplane mode with bundled model
Empty/failure/unsupported script returns correction/manual input options
Corrected text and assessment are separate from immutable original; model/license/toolchain pinned
issues.tests: Clean/blurred/rotated/mixed-script test images; cancellation, p95 latency, byte-level original preservation and network/SDK behavior audit.

issues.title: Evaluate risk rules on held-out synthetic and adversarial cases
issues.scope: Build development and held-out sets totaling at least 120 synthetic cases with template separation, two-person annotation and recorded limitations.
acceptance: Report category confusion matrices, precision/recall, coverage, abstentions and uncertainty intervals
Evaluate SRS targets without tuning on holdout or mislabeling unsupported as benign
Version rules/dataset and publish failures plus allowed product claims
issues.tests: Reproducible evaluation command, leakage/duplicate review, high-concern precision target 0.90 and suspicious recall target 0.80 on held-out synthetic set.

issues.title: Run release security, accessibility and device acceptance suite
issues.scope: Execute release matrix including all exposure combinations, UI/accessibility, storage migration, privacy/network, URI grants and signing/upgrade. Record actual results and remaining limitations.
acceptance: No known critical/high defects; every SRS acceptance has evidence
Backup/D2D, key-loss, delete/export and interrupted-operation tests pass on documented devices
Reference-device latency and usability outcomes recorded with real counts, not assumed success
issues.tests: Full offline journey, canary leakage checks, crash/recovery injection, TalkBack/200% text and signed artifact install/upgrade tests.

issues.title: Prepare reproducible synthetic end-to-end demonstration
issues.scope: Prepare 5–7 minute demo of review, exposure, save/reopen, screenshot/OCR, reviewed export and delete. Use only fictional messages and reserved domains.
acceptance: Demo script and expected outputs reproducible from clean test setup
No actual call/report/submitted suspicious URL or APK execution
Known language/detection/device-recovery limitations are demonstrated or stated
issues.tests: Dry run on target device within time budget; another teammate follows the script.

issues.title: Finalize release handoff, privacy notice and distinct product identity
issues.scope: Publish accurate setup, test results, build/signing/distribution and maintenance instructions. Resolve confusion with Singapore government ScamShield before public distribution; do not rename repository without a separate decision.
acceptance: README distinguishes implemented from planned and links current artifacts
Privacy/retention/export/recovery notice matches measured behavior
Naming and non-affiliation review resolved; release owner checks current distribution obligations and licenses
issues.tests: Fresh developer setup walkthrough, link check, release certificate/checksum verification and documentation review by both teammates.

issues.title: Export selected evidence and incident summary with consent
issues.scope: Create one-way evidence export with text summary and versioned JSON manifest, selection/redaction preview and optional original files. Export crosses the app trust boundary and is not a backup/restore feature.
acceptance: Preview shows exact included originals/derivatives; default summary contains no unintended private fields
Manifest identifies selected files, original/derived status, byte counts and SHA-256 without keys/internal paths
Temporary FileProvider grants/caches expire after 15 minutes and startup cleanup; user warned recipient copies cannot be recalled
issues.tests: Subset/redaction tests, byte digest verification, hostile filenames, recipient access scope, expiry/cancel/restart cleanup and archive manifest schema check.
